audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of the Boat Tunnel repair-introduction event. Every player-facing line, both quick-question choices, and both branch responses were translated with canonical boat, material, iridium, and Fern Islands terminology. Event commands, actors, coordinates, timings, sound IDs, branch delimiters, gender selectors, placeholders, emotes, quoted-string boundaries, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.
